notes.notes: A small patch to fix some overflows on the inventory menu. Happy zoning!

notes.title: 1.2.1 Patch
notes.notes: [p]It was brought to my attention that the backup movement W/A/S/D keys made the character disappear. That sort of breaks the game, right? [/p][p][/p][p]Now that shouldn't happen. Ideally you use the mouse and click and hold to get the best experience, but track pads and other resolutions exist and sometimes it just doesn't work out. W/A/S/D should work now.[/p]

notes.title: 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes: [p]It's that time again, a new batch of updates! In 1.1.0 you'll find:[/p][list][*][p]A skill tree on the character creation screen.[/p][/*][*][p]A toggle-able skill list on the [b]Stats[/b] tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Blinking icons in the bottom right for all status effects.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now attempt to steal items from traders.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thief[/b] feat, which doubles steal and hide checks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Second Chance[/b] feat, which saves you once from a source of damage that would kill you.[/p][/*][*][p]Items now stack, so you will see [b](3) Lemon[/b] instead of [b]Lemon[/b], [b]Lemon[/b], [b]Lemon[/b] ːsteamhappyː[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced animal escape logic:[/p][list][*][p]Animals succeed in running away more often[/p][/*][*][p]Animals aggression can be lowered by attacks with guns (hit or miss)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Many small bugs were fixed as well. Thanks for playing and look forward to the next update![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.0.1 Release Patch
notes.notes: [p]Hello and thanks for playing Qu Zone![/p][p][/p][p]This is the first patch or release in a planned line of several. In this patch the following features were added:[/p][list][*][p]Snow can be foraged on tiles with [b]Freezing[/b] weather. Snow can be eaten to gain water points, but eating three in the span of a day will give you [b]Hypothermia[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]There is a small chance (larger on higher difficulties) or a drought or snow storm event which remove rivers and change tile weathers to snow respectively.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Basket (twigs)[/b] and [b]Basket (branches)[/b] and [b]Wood Spear[/b] items have been added. The baskets are craft-able.[/p][/*][*][p]Water loss on easy mode has been reduced, as play testing showed it was too difficult.[/p][/*][*][p]New dialogs have been added to the tutorial and Demo.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bugs fixed: [/p][list][*][p]Using items in battle without energy points is now blocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Structures now have named tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Ending the day on the exfil tile would occasionally kill you.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and feel free to give any feedback you have. Looking forward to the next update![/p]
